# Incident report — [ID/title]

Status: investigating / contained / recovering / resolved
Detected/start/end times UTC:
Owner, environment and severity:
Affected project/job/attempt/artifact IDs: [sanitized]

## Impact

Data exposure/loss, unavailable workflow, wrong output, spend and unknown charges, affected owner action. Distinguish confirmed impact from suspected impact. No raw credentials, session URLs or private media.

## Timeline and evidence

Symptoms, alerts, configuration changes, request/execution IDs, logs/metrics, fault conditions and containment actions. Exact times and evidence locations.

## Containment and recovery

Pause dispatch, restrict access, rotate credentials, reconcile provider outcome, preserve artifacts, restore/rollback as appropriate. Record approval for destructive/paid actions. Verify resource ownership before any cleanup.

## Cause and corrective action

Contributing factors, code/config/process defects, regression task/test IDs, documentation/runbook changes, owner and target review. Do not substitute a plausible explanation for confirmed cause.

## Closure

Output/data integrity verified, budget reconciled or marked unknown, rights/privacy follow-up recorded, recovery evidence, remaining risks and lessons. Do not call resolved solely because health returns 200.
